title: docs(agents): document console dev server ↔ backend loop + gotchas
body:
Fleshes out the AGENTS.md stub with a 'Local dev — console UI ↔ backend' section: console dev on :5180; the /api proxy defaults to :3000 (run the backend under test there; don't rely on DEV_PROXY_TARGET through `pnpm --filter`); backend-served `_console` is the published build, not src; routes use the app `name` (e.g. `showcase_app`); clearing localStorage logs you out; better-auth needs `localhost`; prefer desktop preview for verification. Captures the gotchas that caused avoidable thrash this session.
